font.reason: Its loaded variable weights and clear small Persian forms preserve the original neutral, Swiss product UI character; 600 is a real supported weight.

comps.translatedSummary: All twelve placeholder initials became compact Persian name initials; the selected initial is «کی», the typed user name is «کیان پارسا», and the caption is «شروع با کیان». No foreign text remains on screen.

rtlDecisions.what: four by three chip grid and target slot
rtlDecisions.action: mirrored every chip x coordinate within the 440px design stage; target remains row two, column two in RTL reading order
rtlDecisions.why: the grid is a list of candidates read from right to left

rtlDecisions.what: Manhattan-distance stagger and each chip's fade/scale
rtlDecisions.action: kept original per-slot distance, start times, easing, opacity and scale values
rtlDecisions.why: the spatial fade still radiates from the same selected candidate after mirroring

rtlDecisions.action: kept the source three-level colour step and cue window
rtlDecisions.why: the hard pressed-state accent has no horizontal direction

rtlDecisions.action: anchored its right edge and grew left from 40px to 190px on the original easing and frames
rtlDecisions.why: the expansion leads toward the Persian reading direction and stays attached to its original chip

rtlDecisions.what: initial and full name inside pill
rtlDecisions.action: anchored both at the right; replaced detached per-character boxes with a shaped prefix from typeOn
rtlDecisions.why: Persian letters must stay joined while the name is typed from right to left

rtlDecisions.action: rescaled the per-character step interval so the first and final character starts match the source g=0.18 and g=0.676 beats
rtlDecisions.why: «کیان پارسا» has a different number of characters from Casey Doe; the phrase must finish on the original beat

rtlDecisions.action: pinned to the moving left tip using right=w-15, retaining its outBack pop and glow
rtlDecisions.why: the tip is now the left end of the growing pill

rtlDecisions.action: drew the 1px line leftward from the final pill tip and mirrored the badge position; kept the four-point symbol unflipped
rtlDecisions.why: the connector progresses in reading direction while the symmetrical badge mark has no directional meaning

rtlDecisions.action: anchored the line at its right edge, used RTL flex order and logical word margins; kept each word's colour cue
rtlDecisions.why: the sentence and word-by-word darkening must advance right to left

rtlDecisions.action: used faText sizes, removed letter spacing and used Persian line height
rtlDecisions.why: tracking breaks joins and Persian dots and descenders need more line space

rtlDecisions.what: badge scale, vertical coordinates, circles, colours, shadows and timing
rtlDecisions.why: these are physical or symmetric rather than reading-direction cues

visualEvidence.findings: Grid order, selection flash, distance fade, right-anchored pill growth, leftward line, badge handoff and final caption match the source beats. The final name and caption fit with no visible clipping.

rasterTextHandling: No raster or video assets are used by this card; there is no baked-in foreign text.
concerns: The source gives each Latin letter a short independent opacity and 2px rise. The Persian name instead reveals one newly shaped prefix step at a time, so every letter stays correctly joined; the first and last typing beats remain aligned.

lessons.symptom: A temporary Persian name ending in the partial prefix «کیان رض» rendered only its final glyph at one intermediate frame, even though adjacent prefix frames rendered normally.
lessons.cause: The exact Chromium shaping or clipping interaction for that incomplete prefix was not isolated.
lessons.fix: Use an equally natural name without that problematic intermediate prefix and inspect consecutive frames across every letter transition. «کیان پارسا» rendered all inspected prefixes correctly.
